root_cause_analysis.symptom: Parent cycle close failed with verdict CLOSE: NO; Codex round 1b' found 3 in_scope_real_bug blockers.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: B1: validator exit-code semantics (return 2 on warnings-only) drift from AC2 literal text and from CLI severity-alignment convention. B2: pretool-block-production-files.sh dispatch table only includes Write|Edit; data agents canonical write surface is Bash via scripts/save.py — entire AC9 control is bypassable. B3: W4 of parent cycle created .claude/.hook-refactor-allow as a temporary opt-in but never deleted it; auto-commit captured it (commit cab2600 2026-05-06T00:00:09Z); .gitignore never covered it; the global guard exits 0 unconditionally while the file exists, disabling protection on .claude/commands/ and .claude/hooks/.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: B1: pre-existing (validator behavior since creation); B2: 5fd0da8 / parent cycle W6 dev-report-20260505-231740-W6.json (extension landed in Write|Edit branch); B3: cab2600 (2026-05-06T00:00:09Z auto-commit captured the W4 sentinel).
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: B1: prior author chose exit 2 for 'warnings present' as a tri-state signal. B2: architect concern_6 explicitly bound 'single hook'; W6 dev correctly stayed in one hook but did not enumerate the Bash dispatch case because the existing case lattice only had Write|Edit. B3: W4 needed to Edit a .claude/commands file under the protection guard; the documented override is the sentinel; the cleanup step (delete sentinel after operation) was missed; auto-commit then captured the file because no .gitignore entry existed.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: B1: violates Section 5.2 control 5 (AC literal text must match verification output). Also violates the standard CLI convention readers expect. B2: the hook does not enforce on the actual write surface, so AC9's universal image_url deny + ownership are theoretical only. B3: the protection guard ships disabled in every checkout of the repo until removed.
